Parent page: four calmer layouts

All four keep the Editorial Cookbook look (ivory, serif headlines, wine red). They differ in how the page is arranged. Pick one (or mix, e.g. “L3 but with L1’s header”) and I’ll build it.

Why it feels cluttered now

  • 7 stacked blocks before you reach your food: account card, storage note, hero, add form, settings form, help card, “added” banner.
  • Every pantry row has 3 lines of small text (“Amount not entered · fridge / No amount entered…”).
  • Budget, people, equipment and allergies all show at once, even though they rarely change.
  • Two nav bars (the top “Adult meal planner” strip and the main tabs).

What changes:
  • Pantry becomes removable chips under one search bar; amounts/storage move to a tap-to-edit popover.
  • Budget/people become one line of text; equipment & allergies move behind ⚙ settings.
  • Account, “saved on this device” and food-help move to the ⚙ menu and footer.
Inspired by Julienne, HelloFresh. Best for: the simplest, friendliest page.
